项目 JSON 保存设备和统一任务，不保存密码。证据保存在项目同级 eviden: Project JSON stores devices and tasks, never passwords. Evidence is stored beside the project.
SSH 连通测试（运行版本查询，使用设置页凭据）: Test SSH connection (version query; credentials from Settings)
Hostname被任务引用后不允许修改；需要先删除关联任务。SSH 测试结果也会: Hostname cannot change while referenced by tasks. Remove those tasks first. SSH tests also save evidence.
至少填写一个查询步骤: Enter at least one query step
勾选测试项；命令需按实际型号核对，默认结论待复核: Check tests. Verify commands for your model. Results require review by default.
至少选择一台设备和一个测试项: Select at least one device and one test
删除队列中所有任务？: Delete all tests from the queue?
请在设置页输入 SSH 密码: Enter the SSH password in Settings
已请求停止；等待当前 SSH 调用结束或超时。: Stop requested. Waiting for the current SSH call to finish or time out.
备注（N/A 与带意见通过需说明原因）: Remarks (required for N/A or pass with comments)
请在结果页选中需要复测的记录，可多选: Select records to retest in Results (multiple allowed)
导出当前项目全部证据 ZIP: Export all project evidence as ZIP
导出结果与证据索引 CSV: Export results and evidence index as CSV
ZIP 请保存到证据目录以外: Save the ZIP outside the evidence folder
SSH 默认用户名（设备上的用户名优先）: Default SSH username (device username takes priority)
SSH 密码（只保留在内存，运行后清除）: SSH password (memory only, cleared after run)
超时（秒）；连接、认证、命令各阶段使用此值: Timeout in seconds (applies to connection, authentication and commands)
请先停止后续任务，等待当前调用结束后再关闭。: Stop pending tests and wait for the current call to finish before closing.
管理地址必须填写有效 IP:: A valid management IP is required:
SSH 端口超出范围: SSH port is out of range
步骤必须为命令列表: Steps must be a list of commands
命令必须为非空的单行文本: Command must be a non-empty single line
首批模板仅支持 cisco_ios / huawei_vrp:: Starter templates support cisco_ios / huawei_vrp only:
按批准设计人工核对；填写项目预期值后复核: Review against the approved design and project baseline
按日期时间归档；文件以设备名称-IP-命令命名，附带 Test ID 与重复序号:
Archived by run time; names contain device, IP, operation and test ID.
Reviews are stored separately in review.json. PNG files render CLI text.
SSH 严格校验主机密钥。首次连接请用 Windows OpenSSH 登录并核:
SSH host keys are verified strictly. On first connection, verify the fingerprint
and add the device to ~/.ssh/known_hosts using OpenSSH.
Sequential execution with password authentication; no automatic enable or configuration changes.
从 Excel 导入设备和凭据: Import devices and credentials from Excel
请在设备页填写每台设备的 SSH 用户名和密码: Enter an SSH username and password for each device on the Devices page
项目保存设备、任务和本机加密凭据；证据位于项目同级 evidence 目录。: Project stores devices, tests and locally encrypted credentials. Evidence is stored beside the project.
运行结束。设备凭据保留于当前项目，输入框已清除。: Run finished. Device credentials remain in the project; input field cleared.
